messages:
Priya R.: Heads-up: new capacity update. Were introducing A800S "ephemeral" slots in Santiago (SCL) and Jakarta (JKT) as a limited preview next week. :sparkles:
Priya R.: These are carved from reserved micro-pools and can be offered to other customers when idle, then reclaimed quickly for the reservation owner.
Omar H.: Key behavior: ephemeral slots are evict-first, reclaimable with a short reclaim_window. Owner keeps their reservation billing and reclaim priority.
Janet S.: Timing: preview canary starts 2025-06-08 in SCL and 2025-06-09 in JKT. Expect small-scale pools (4x8, 2x16) initially.
Kai M.: Console changes: 'Ephemeral usage' band in pool view, reclaim timeline, and an opt-out toggle at reservation level. API flags: ephemeral_enabled and ephemeral_grace_seconds.
ops-bot: Canary checklist created: attach-pool -> enable-ephemeral -> run-reclaim-test -> collect-metrics.
Omar H.: Performance goal: median reclaim handshake <15s. Well publish telemetry: reservations.ephemeral.util, reservations.reclaim.latency, reservations.ephemeral.evictions.
Janet S.: Support & billing notes: committed customers continue to pay committed fees; ephemeral consumers billed at ephemeral_rate (lower). Support KB and billing FAQ to follow.
Priya R.: Policy change: default for new micro-pools is ephemeral_enabled=true. Existing reservations will remain unchanged unless customer opts in. Admins can override globally.
Kai M.: Action items:
- Omar: finalize API names and deploy control-plane flags (by 2025-05-31)
- Janet: draft customer email and KB (by 2025-06-01)
- Ops: sign-ups for canary testers in this thread
Priya R.: Thanks team. Ping me if you want early access or have contract concerns. :rocket:
